title: console AI chat: a message sent while image/PDF attachments are still uploading can reach the agent before the turn that carries them
body:
repo:objectstack#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5obaLbqgzRUR9xXfft

Filing gate: ① reproducible defect, read from code (not measured in a browser). Introduced by PR #34459 (#32749 console half) and named by L1-b record 6928835635.

## Symptom

When a user sends a turn with image or PDF attachments, the composer clears at once, but the user's message is only sent after the uploads settle (seconds for a large photo). There is no busy state, so a second message typed meanwhile is sent first, and the agent sees the two turns out of order.

## Location

`ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` `doSend` (awaits `uploadChatAttachments` before `sendMessage`), and the composer's submit path, which does not wait.

## Acceptance

1. While a turn's attachments upload, the composer shows a busy state and does not send another turn, or later turns queue behind it; the turns reach the agent in the order the user sent them.
2. Pins: a second send during a slow upload arrives after the first turn; an upload failure releases the busy state; CONTROL: a turn with no attachment sends at once.

## Related

#32749, PR #34459 (Acceptance notes).

Dedupe: searched open issues on 2026-11-16 for `AI chat upload busy state` (4 hits: #32749 and PM seat posts) and `chat attachment message order` (11 hits: #32749, #34460 and PM seat posts); none reports this.
